file_spec.value: No applicant-submitted photo file is required. The official document checklist for passport issuance/renewal (current passport or laminated cédula, appointment form 'planilla de cita', and consular fee) does not include bringing a photo — SAIME captures the photograph and fingerprints live, on-site, at the in-person appointment.

cross_verification.note_en: SAIME (Servicio Administrativo de Identificación, Migración y Extranjería, saime.gob.ve — Venezuela's official identification/passport authority) and its consular offices abroad (verified via the official Venezuelan Consulate General in Barcelona, consuladobarcelona.gob.ve, a gob.ve government domain) both describe a passport process where the applicant is photographed and fingerprinted live by an official at the appointment, rather than submitting a pre-taken photo. This explains why no official .gob.ve page publishes consumer-facing photo composition specs (size/background/head-height/etc.) for the passport — there is genuinely no such applicant-facing requirement to publish. DB values (2×2in / white / 3.4-3.8cm) could not be confirmed or refuted against any official source describing applicant-submitted photos, so no db_conflicts entry is asserted.
